classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: a tamer level 1..50 with its own EXP and a four-line talent tree whose points are worked out from the level, the title rank and the Dex (LINE_FUSION_TAMER_TALENTS_DESIGN_20261117); a talent is a modifier read where the game works a value out and never writes a native individual, a save word or a battle code

saveField.path: progression.tamerTalents = { version: 1, level, exp, nodes: { [nodeId]: rank }, keystones: { [line]: keystoneId }, respecs, daily?: { day: YYYY-MM-DD, care: 0..60, hunt, battle } }
saveField.migration: none: a save without it is Lv.1 with nothing spent; an unknown shape starts again; ranks are clamped to the node and a keystone of another line is dropped (productTamerTalents.normalizeTamerTalents)

rules.points: points = (level - 1) + 2 x title rank + floor(registered species / 25), never stored; the whole tree costs 124; the friends playtest opens all 124
rules.level: EXP to the next level = round(40 x level^1.3); Lv.50 is the cap
rules.exp: a catch brought Home 20 x grade (S 1.6, A 1.25, B 1.0, C 0.8); a fusion 8 a fodder; a settled owned-party battle TITLE/CHAMPIONSHIP 60, FREE/ARENA 30, PRACTICE 5 (a loss 40 %); a journey star not earned before 15; a tower floor first clear 40; a care action (feed, clean, treat) 2 up to 60 a day; the first hunt and the first battle of the player's local day 100 each. Paid in the save of what earned it, or carried by the next save where the action has none of its own; password, link and online battles pay none; the tutorial pays none
rules.tree: four lines x three tiers x three nodes (a rank one point; tiers open at 6 and 14 points spent in the line's nodes) and two keystones a line of which one is taken (4 points at 22)
rules.respec: every point back, keystones included; the first is free, then 500 crystals
rules.titleCap: title matches and championships count only the first 6 + 3 x rank commander points: tier one, two, three, each node rank by rank across the tier, the keystone last
rules.open: a node is offered only once its effect is wired (TALENT_WIRED_KEYS); the rest show as not open and take no point

wiredT1.memoryG: hunter 記憶擴充: memory card +8 G a rank (huntMemoryCapacityG)
wiredT1.huntSeconds: hunter 長息: real-time hunt +5 s a rank
wiredT1.herdExtra: hunter 群聚嗅覺: herd +1 a rank, still at most 20 partners
wiredT1.gradeHighPercent: hunter 識貨: S and A chance +10 % of themselves a rank, taken from C then B
wiredT1.growthPercent: breeder 精心照料: training stat gains +4 % a rank on top of the habitat bonus
wiredT1.nightDisturbPercent: breeder 守夜: 15 % a rank that a handled sleeper is not disturbed (product roll)
wiredT1.fusionExpPercent: breeder 同調融合: fusion base share +10 % a rank (not the EXP the fodder carried)
wiredT1.fusionLowerLine: breeder 同線親和: lower-stage line share +0.1 a rank, 0.6 up to 0.9
wiredT1.syncExpPercent: commander 同步訓練: battle Sync EXP +5 % a rank
wiredT1.crystalPercent: trader 結晶: crystals paid by tower, zones and patrol +10 % a rank

wiredT2.coreTimePercent: breeder 自動化: a core lasts 10 % longer a rank. The run clock drains that much slower, so the save never holds more than a core's own hour (a removed cage refunds whole stored hours); every clock shown is the stored seconds stretched by the same share
wiredT2.supplementPercent: breeder 藥膳: 親密零食, 成長粉 and 同步飲 give 10 % more a rank, rounded to a whole (5 -> 7 affection, 15 -> 20 % growth, 50 -> 65 % Sync EXP at three ranks). A curve step stays one whole step; 元氣飲 and 安眠香 have no number to raise
wiredT2.supplementBattles: breeder 長效: a carried pre-battle supplement lasts one more settled battle a rank (at most 4). One that has been through a battle cannot be taken off or swapped out: it stays until it is used up
wiredT2.battleBitsPercent: trader 賞金: +5 % a rank on the Bits purse of a won owned-party match (title, free, practice) and on the tournament prize, as a product credit beside the original one, inside the wallet cap. Password and link battles never read it
wiredT2.patrolPercent: trader 巡邏: patrol pod and quick patrol crystals +10 % a rank, added to 結晶's share
wiredT2.towerRewardPercent: trader 塔: a tower floor's first-clear crystals +10 % a rank, added to 結晶's share. The tower pays no Bits; tickets and diamonds are not changed
wiredT2.firstSupplyDiscountPercent: trader 熟客: the first supplement unit bought each local day costs 15 % less a rank (rounded down); the day is recorded in the bag only when the discount is used
wiredT2.supplySlots: trader 補給帶 (one rank, three points): a partner carries two different pre-battle supplements

wiredT3.where: battle/battleTaxonomyAdaptation.js takes a `commander` for the local team (application: getBattleCommander(mode)). Tournaments and title matches count the first 6 + 3 x rank commander points, Free Battle and Practice all of them; password and link battles get none. It acts under either taxonomy policy; the three resonance talents need their resonance lit.
wiredT3.openingTpPercent: commander 先手: opening TP +5 % a rank, added to Black Iron's own opening share
wiredT3.moodCapPercent: commander 好心情: the best mood's TP share +1 point a rank (10 % up to 13 %); other moods unchanged. It is part of the battle copy, so the stale-preparation checks rebuild it with the same number (individual.moodCap)
wiredT3.resonanceLumenPercent: commander 心輝共鳴: Lumen's bonus part +20 % a rank (damage taken 90 % -> 84 %, regen 1 % -> 1.6 % at three ranks)
wiredT3.resonanceIronPercent: commander 黑鐵共鳴: Black Iron's bonus part +20 % a rank (opening TP 120 % -> 132 %, defence 108 % -> 112.8 %)
wiredT3.resonanceRiftPercent: commander 裂隙共鳴: Rift's bonus part +20 % a rank (crit +10 -> +16, signature 115 % -> 124 %)
wiredT3.lowHpDefensePercent: commander 逆境: under 30 % HP, damage taken / (1 + 5 % a rank)
wiredT3.ultimatePercent: commander 必殺: the signature move (its costliest) +3 % a rank
wiredT3.elitePercent: hunter 野性嗅覺: the elite share of a hunt's instinct roll +30 % of itself a rank; the hunt's limit of one elite is not raised
wiredT3.notYet: the Data Arena does not read the commander line yet; 蓄能 (opening awakening energy) is not wired

wiredT4.shopBitsPercent: trader 殺價: the shop runtime charges and shows every Bits price (rows, hunt tool tiers, refills, the emergency rope refill) at 100 - 3 x rank percent of the catalog price, rounded up and never below 1; the catalog price stays readable as listPriceBits. Diamond prices, the gachapon and the supplement shelf do not pass through it. A share outside 50..100 is ignored, so a save, a parity test and the tutorial read the catalog
wiredT4.scavengePercent: trader 拾荒: at a hunt's end, 10 % a rank that one basic supplement (元氣飲, 親密零食 or 安眠香) goes into the bag, with a catch or without; the hunt end gate and the Hunt Result name it; capture replays and the tutorial find none; a full stack finds nothing
wiredT4.strollBitsPercent: trader 鑑價: Bits a stroll find pays +10 % a rank, when the find is collected
wiredT4.strollExtraPercent: breeder 散步好運: 10 % a rank that a solo stroll find brings one more (a find is at most two; no extra draw without the talent)

wiredT5.moodDecayPercent: breeder 安撫: the mood is a score, not a clock, so 'falls 10 % slower' is read as: everything that pulls the score down (illness, injury, hurt, hunger, sleepiness, dirt, a poor habitat, a disturbed night) pulls 10 % less a rank, at most 30 %; what lifts it is unchanged

keystones.commander.pureFaction: 純色陣營: with three partners of one faction, that faction's resonance bonus is half as large again (added to its resonance talent's share); the commander's team only
keystones.commander.triColor: 三色指揮: the commander's Tri-core gives 114 % attack and defence and 125 % rewards (108 / 108 / 115 without it)
keystones.trader.bountyHunter: 賞金獵人: the bounty beacon's extra Bits on a won match are half as large again

wiredT5.rule: a keystone costs 4 points at 22 points in its line's nodes and a line takes one of its two; the commander's keystone is dropped with the rest of the line by the 6 + 3 x rank cap in title matches and tournaments

wiredT6.breeder.inherit: 傳承 (fusion plan P4): only with this keystone, a fusion also gives the base one unit (10 HP, 1 of the others) of each of the six stats where a fodder's quality is above the base's, per fodder, never past the individual's own upper bound; HP and TP raise their current value by the same amount. A base without a grade counts as quality 50; a fodder without a grade hands over nothing. It is the one talent that writes native individual fields, as the plan says, and it stays inside their bounds
wiredT6.saves: a ranch fusion writes the base in the fusion's own save and puts it back if the save fails; the Hunt Result's staged fusions write the bases on the save candidates only, so a refused or failed Home commit changes no partner
wiredT6.preview: both fusion previews carry `inherit` (the stats that would rise) and print how many

wiredT7.ammoSavePercent: hunter 省彈: 10 % a rank that a shot costs no ammunition. It is decided in the ordinary hunt's own consume callback (the application's, not the native field code): only an item of class SHOT, only when one round is held, never in a capture replay; the tutorial hunt has its own callback and never reads it. The shot itself is fired as usual

crystalsFeedTamerR1.rule: the EXP crystals (six zones, tower, patrol pod, fusion overflow) raise the tamer: 1 crystal = 1 tamer EXP, poured from the Journey's feed page in one save; nothing is spent past Lv.50 (137,370 EXP from Lv.1)
crystalsFeedTamerR1.partners: a partner no longer takes crystals (the application refuses with CRYSTALS_FEED_TAMER); its Sync level comes from fusing its own kind and from the Sync EXP a battle pays, which is unchanged
crystalsFeedTamerR1.save: no new field and no migration: the crystals stay at progression.syncLevels.crystals, the tamer at progression.tamerTalents; crystals held in an older save are kept as they are
crystalsFeedTamerR1.otherUses: a talent reset after the first still costs 500 crystals

levelUnlocksR1b.rule: a shop row, a hunt tool or a hunt gate that asks for a tamer rank opens at that rank OR at the tamer level that stands for it: 5 levels a rank, Lv.5 = rank 1 ... Lv.45 = rank 9 (EXP from Lv.1: 548, 3,078, 8,149, 16,114, 27,245, 41,767, 59,875, 81,743, 107,528)
levelUnlocksR1b.reads: only the shop, the hunt tools and the gates (the application's progression context); the tutorial reads the title rank alone
levelUnlocksR1b.unchanged: the title rank itself, the title matches and championships, the ranch land, the generation licence and capacity, the Sync cap, the burst tier, the capped commander points, the rank diamond rewards; a row or gate that asks for a title badge still asks for the badge
levelUnlocksR1b.save: no new field: the rank is read from progression.tamerRank and progression.tamerTalents.level every time
levelUnlocksR1b.copy: gate: 階級 {rank} 或馴獸師 Lv.{level} 開放。; shop: 尚未開放：階級「{rank}」或馴獸師 Lv.{level}。; rank overview: 狩獵場、商店：馴獸師每 5 級也算 1 階; talent panel: Lv.{level}：開{rank}商店・狩獵場

treePresentation.owner: 2026-11-18: the talent screen was a list of text; it is to be a tree of icons where a tap lights a node and a press-and-hold shows what it does, and the systems are to read at a glance without long explanations
treePresentation.rules: unchanged: the same nodes, tiers, gates, costs, keystones and reset

layers.glance: the tamer's level badge and EXP gauge, the free points as an orb with a number, four line emblems, and the chosen line's tree: keystones on top, tiers 3, 2, 1 below, each node an icon with rank pips, each tier gate a padlock strip with spent / needed
layers.tap: a node that can be learned takes one rank and lights up (stamp, ring, sparkle cue; level-up cue at its last rank); a node that cannot be learned shakes with the denied cue and the reading bar says why
layers.hold: a press of 320 ms or more (or a mouse hover, or keyboard focus) writes the node's name and effect into the reading bar; its release does not learn

treePresentation.states: soon (effect not built, hatched, never takes a point), locked (grey), ready (colour, pulsing gold glow), lit, max (gold ring)
treePresentation.art: art:ui:talent-icons:r1 (48 Codex stickers: 44 nodes and keystones, 4 line emblems; ORIGINAL_GENERATED); an icon that cannot load is a drawn gem in the line's colour
treePresentation.words: only names in the reading bar and accessible names, plus three short strings (hint, 二選一, the gate label)

notYetOpen: 4 nodes and 4 keystones: hunter 繩索保養, 疾步, 穩手 and the keystones 慧眼, 連獵 (they change the native hunt's rope durability, movement and status timing); commander 蓄能 (the plan does not say which meter it fills); breeder 萃取; trader 行商 (it needs the higher supplement grade, which is not built)
notChanged: the native individual fields, battle codes and match tables
the gachapon rates, diamond prices and diamond or ticket rewards
the tutorial hunt, capture replays and parity tests (no talent applies)
authorization: Owner 2026-11-17 standing goal: decided non-animation designs are implemented, integrated, verified and shipped batch by batch without asking per batch.
